rationale: The agent did look up the user via name and ZIP and accessed order/product details, suggesting authentication and order scoping were attempted. However, it executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) without obtaining explicit user confirmation beforehand, which violates the policy requiring confirmation for any order-changing write. The agent also did not present final exchange details to the user (item IDs, order, pricing differences, shipping/return steps), and it selected a payment method (gift card) without documented consent. While it may have chosen a replacement item, there is no evidence it verified that it was the cheapest earbud in that order or matched the requested water resistance. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
